rationale: The amendment now asks the executable question: whether assigned private evidence-check text changes correct manifest publication under an invented, unverified public handoff assertion. Its five cited messages are accurately scoped to intentions, questions and self-reported dependencies or updates. The ordinary previous-shift assertion no longer mentions an intervention or an unenforced verifier gate. The declared three-role actions, repeatable turn-costing waits, four-round stopping rule, exact publication oracle and fixed active-versus-neutral contrast match the reviewed implementation. This is approval of a bounded synthetic analogue, not validation of the historical waiting mechanism, a completed hosted review, a subject result or an expected effect direction.
limitations: The source check authenticates the exact stored object versions and cited record membership. It does not freshly reread raw archive rows or independently verify reported computer use, artifact availability, edits, success or causal dependence.

The initial 0.5 validity probability, defect modes, manifest quantities, previous-shift assertion, role privileges and schedule are synthetic assumptions. This world does not operationalize independent work, artifact-release gates, once-only resumption, physical computer occupation or elapsed inactivity.

Both fixed notes contain 36 whitespace-delimited words, but their characters are 218 and 236 and their tokenizer-specific lengths and semantic effects may differ. The neutral note is not guaranteed psychologically inert; any future causal claim is about total assignment of these specific texts under registered execution assumptions.

The outcome is exact executed publication. Current-version inspection by any role satisfies inspected_publication, without requiring verifier confirmation or proving comparison, belief updating, receipt interpretation or latent verification. Correct publication can occur without inspection when the initial manifest is valid.

The existing oracle returns inspections and messages_sent. Repair attempts and successful repairs are observable in action events, but repairs is not a named existing oracle outcome or registered secondary metric. Any derived repair count must state which events it counts and remain descriptive; none of these post-treatment process measures identify mediation.

The existing default offline_policy deliberately responds to note contents, as the final amendment now explicitly states. Execution with that allowlisted policy can validate the cycle, archives and replay; any arm differences are outputs of scripted assumptions and independent synthetic draws, not empirical effects in an LLM population. There is no presumption that a scripted arm contrast must equal zero.

Whole-swarm assignment includes within-run communication spillovers and differing trajectories. It does not identify individual direct effects, network mechanisms or historical transport. Small pilots, hosted-model drift, statelessness and backend stability retain their registered limitations; no winning arm or generality is established.

This supplied development-agent review is separate from the failed or capped hosted reviewer. Compiler approval does not certify reviewer independence, semantic truth, public preregistration or freedom from all confounding. Preserve the original failed attempt and all existing null, negative and incomplete results.
